name: Bodyweight Squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower hips until thighs are parallel to floor, then stand back up.

name: Push-Up
description: Start in plank position, lower chest to floor keeping body straight, then push back up.

name: Knee Push-Up
description: Same as a push-up but with knees on the floor — great for beginners building upper body strength.

name: Forward Lunge
description: Step one foot forward, lower back knee toward floor, return to start. Alternate legs.

name: Plank Hold
description: Hold a push-up position on forearms, keeping the body in a straight line from head to heels.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Lie on back with knees bent, push hips toward ceiling squeezing glutes at the top.

name: Mountain Climber
description: Start in plank position, alternate driving knees to chest in a running motion.

name: Burpee
description: Squat down, jump feet back to plank, do a push-up, jump feet forward, jump up with arms overhead.

name: Jump Squat
description: Perform a squat then explosively jump, land softly and immediately lower into next squat.

name: Chair Tricep Dip
description: Place hands on a sturdy chair behind you, lower body by bending elbows, then push back up.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, rise onto toes, hold 1 second, lower slowly.

name: Superman Hold
description: Lie face down, simultaneously lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor, hold, lower.

name: High Knees
description: Run in place, driving knees as high as possible. Pump arms for extra intensity.

name: Side Plank
description: Lie on side, prop up on one forearm, lift hips to form a straight line. Hold, then switch sides.

name: Wall Sit
description: Slide back down a wall until thighs are parallel to floor, hold position.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Lie on back, hands behind head, alternate bringing elbow to opposite knee in a cycling motion.

name: Inchworm
description: Stand and hinge at hips, walk hands forward to plank, pause, walk feet to hands, stand.

name: Arm Circles
description: Extend arms to sides, make small to large circles forward, then reverse.

name: Lying Leg Raise
description: Lie on back, keep legs straight, raise them to 90° and slowly lower without touching floor.

name: Jumping Jack
description: Jump feet apart while raising arms overhead, jump feet together while lowering arms.
